systems.system: National Data Centre, Statistics House, Kampala

UGA.note: The National Data Centre is described as built for e-government services; renting to outside customers is not stated.
Nothing on services people can use online.

facts.fact: The Daily Monitor says NBI phase one (completed June 2008) laid 168 km linking Kampala to Mukono, Bombo and Jinja, and phase two (2009 to 2013) laid 1,400 km linking Busia, Mbale, Soroti, Lira, Gulu, Fort Portal, Kasese, Mbarara and other towns.

The Daily Monitor says NITA-U hired the Kenyan company Soliton Telmec in 2018 to manage and commercialise the National Backbone Infrastructure, a contract meant to run to 2028 that the government agreed to cancel.

UGA.note: Mentions only the NBI linking government offices, with no local government office stated.

facts.fact: The Daily Monitor says the government's National Data Centre at Statistics House in Kampala was built to manage all e-government services on the NBI.
